guide.welcomeBody: Let me show you around. It takes about one minute.

navTalk.title: Talk
navTalk.body: This is where you speak. Echo says your words clearly for the person you are talking to.

navEnroll.title: Teach Echo your voice
navEnroll.body: Record a few short phrases. The more Echo hears you, the better it understands you.

navWords.title: Names and places
navWords.body: Add names of people and places you say often, so Echo gets them right.

navSettings.title: Settings
navSettings.body: Change the app language, the colours and the voice Echo uses.

talkRecord.title: Microphone
talkRecord.body: Press it and say what you want. Echo listens, then says it clearly for the person you are talking to.

newConversation.title: New conversation
newConversation.body: Start again with a clean page.

learned.title: Sentences learned
learned.body: How many of your sentences Echo has learned. It grows every time a sentence is right.

health.title: Connection
health.body: Green dots mean Echo is connected and ready to help.

guideButton.title: This guide
guideButton.body: Open this guide again any time from here.

enrollProgress.title: Your progress
enrollProgress.body: How many phrases you have recorded so far.

enrollLanguage.title: Language
enrollLanguage.body: Choose which language's phrases to record.

enrollStart.title: Start
enrollStart.body: Press to begin. Echo says each phrase out loud, then you repeat it.

enrollPhrase.title: The phrase
enrollPhrase.body: The picture shows the phrase. Press the speaker to hear it again.

enrollSkip.title: Skip
enrollSkip.body: Skip a phrase you don't want to say.

enrollRecord.title: Record
enrollRecord.body: Press the microphone and repeat the phrase. You can listen to it before you save it.

enrollFinished.title: All done
enrollFinished.body: Add the names and places you use, go home to start talking, or record the phrases again.

wordsTabs.title: Kinds of words
wordsTabs.body: People, places, pets and other words each have their own tab.

wordsAdd.title: Add a word
wordsAdd.body: Type a name here and press plus. A helper can do this for you.

wordsRecord.title: Say the word
wordsRecord.body: Record yourself saying the word, so Echo learns how you say it.

settingsLanguage.title: App language
settingsLanguage.body: The language of the buttons, messages and spoken prompts.

settingsTheme.title: Colours
settingsTheme.body: Pick light or dark colours, whichever is easier on your eyes.

settingsVoice.title: Echo's voice
settingsVoice.body: The voice Echo speaks your sentences with. Tap a voice to hear it.

settingsPrivacy.title: Your data
settingsPrivacy.body: Delete all your recordings and words from Echo at any time.

onbName.title: Your name
onbName.body: Type the name of the person who will use Echo. A family member or helper can fill this in.

onbLanguage.title: Language
onbLanguage.body: Pick the language you speak: English, Turkish, or both.

onbConsent.title: Your recordings
onbConsent.body: How Echo keeps your recordings private. Press the speaker to hear it read aloud.

onbAgree.title: I agree
onbAgree.body: Tick this to agree, so Echo can record your voice and learn from it.

onbContinue.title: Continue
onbContinue.body: When the name is filled in and you agree, press here to start teaching Echo your voice.

onbDemo.title: Try the demo
onbDemo.body: Try Echo with a ready-trained example account, without signing up.

checkGuess.title: Echo's guess
checkGuess.body: Echo isn't sure, so it shows you its guess first and plays it quietly for you only. Press the speaker to hear it again.

checkDown.title: Thumbs down
checkDown.body: Press if the sentence is wrong. Echo asks you to say it again; after two wrong tries it asks a helper.

checkUp.title: Thumbs up
checkUp.body: Press if the sentence is right. Echo says it out loud to the other person and learns from it.

writeIt.title: Write what you meant
writeIt.body: Type the right sentence yourself. Echo says it out loud and learns from it.

spokenSentence.title: What Echo said
spokenSentence.body: The sentence Echo said out loud, in big letters for the other person to read.

undoDown.title: Was it wrong?
undoDown.body: Echo was sure, so it spoke straight away. If it got it wrong, press here before the ring runs out. The ring waits while this guide is open.

showListener.title: Show to listener
showListener.body: Fill the screen with the sentence so the other person can read it. Tap anywhere to close; the flip button turns it around for someone sitting opposite.

repeat.title: Say it again
repeat.body: Echo didn't get it right. Press the microphone and say your sentence once more.

helperIcon.title: Ask a helper
helperIcon.body: After two wrong guesses Echo stops guessing. Press here so a helper can type what you meant.

helperForm.title: Type the sentence
helperForm.body: Type what was meant and press send. Echo says it out loud and remembers it for next time.

writeCancel.title: Go back
writeCancel.body: Pressed by mistake? Go back to Echo's guess.

enrollRedo.title: Record again
enrollRedo.body: Not happy with it? Record the phrase again.

enrollListen.title: Listen
enrollListen.body: Hear your recording before you save it.

enrollSave.title: Save and next
enrollSave.body: Save this recording and go to the next phrase.

wordsDelete.title: Delete
wordsDelete.body: Remove a word you don't need any more.
